Name: FarmerBeans' Premium Farm Building Repaints for SVE - Coop Barn  Winery Grandpa's Shed
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Premium Farm Building Repaints for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)
[/b][/size]For Content Patcher

Replaces the Premium Coop, Premium Barn, Winery and Grandpa's Shed textures in Stardew Valley Expanded. Barns and coops come with color variations; choose from White (default) Green or Red  color schemes. All buildings (except Grandpa's Shed) can all be painted-over by visiting robin's building upgrade menu.

This mod does [b]not [/b]affect the functionality or price of the buildings. 

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Replaces Premium Coop and Premium Barn buildings with options for red, green or white paint as a base . Includes seasonal recolor. (custom paintable at Robin's)[/size]
[*][size=3]Replaces the Winery and includes seasonal recolor (custom paintable at Robin's)[/size]
[*][size=3]Replaces Grandpa's Shed and includes seasonal recolors[/size]
[/list][b]
[size=4]Looking for matching Base-game barns and coops? [/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32014][size=3]It's over here![/size][/url]
[b]
